name: placebo-paired-desk_tempho_1975
cmd: set -e; for spec in 'C0 --kernel iso' 'C1 --kernel split' 'P --kernel placebo' 'CP --kernel split+placebo'; do set -- $spec; n=$1; shift; {python} research/exp/fast_arm.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1975 --out {out}/$n --tag E012c_$n --dump-change "$@" > /dev/null; done; for pr in 'C1 P' 'CP P' 'C1 C0' 'P C0'; do set -- $pr; {python} research/exp/paired_arms.py {out}/$1 {out}/$2 --out {out}/paired_$1_vs_$2.json > /dev/null; done
summarize: for pr in 'C1 P' 'CP P' 'C1 C0' 'P C0'; do set -- $pr; {python} research/exp/paired_arms.py {out}/$1 {out}/$2 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'paired|(time|space)[a-z_ ]+(place|total)/(0.1|0.3)'; done
